paragraphs: Rabbi Ilai bar Berekhiah, Ta'anit 10b; end of Sotah 49a, where the reading is Yevarekhiah. He said several things. Another reading: Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Berekhiah, Sanhedrin 94b. In Rabbi Yochanan’s name, there 104b.
